base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE raster status-effect icon for a dark fantasy RPG HUD, designed to read clearly at only 32 pixels. One centered compact symbol filling about 80% of a square canvas, angular hand-inked heraldic graphic, sharp tapering silhouette, bold near-black outlines, flat limited-color fills with one restrained highlight, matching an existing set of crimson bleeding claws, icy-blue shields, violet mana flames and pale-gold scrolls. Genuine transparent background, clean alpha, no background color, no tile, no badge frame, no letters, no numbers, no words, no watermark, no soft smoky halo, no photorealism, no decorative particles. Subject:
packaging: Exact alpha-bounds crop, Lanczos downscale to fit 128x128, centered on transparent 144x144 canvas. No halo removal or alpha thresholding.
